thread:
Alex: quick follow-up on the autoscale RFC. we need a compactness metric for dedicated GPU pools: balance prewarm latency, idle cost, and eviction churn. proposal: compactness = a*normalized_p95_cold + b*normalized_idle_ratio + c*normalized_unexpected_eviction_rate. thoughts?

Jamie: makes sense. couple questions: how normalize (historical percentiles?) and do we compute p95 per-tenant or cluster-wide?

Alex: normalize by rolling 30d percentiles per tenant+pool so terms map to [0,1]. prefer per-tenant p95 for fairness; fallback to cluster when tenant data sparse.

Sara: we must expose component breakdown for cost transparency. one scalar is fine for internal decisions but show cost vs latency breakdown in the UI/reporting.

Phil: ownership: runtime ships safe defaults. product can request tenant-level profile overrides (latency-first, balanced, cost-first). need RBAC + audit for overrides.

Mika: agree on named profiles mapping to weight presets. avoids exposing raw weights to sales.

Jamie: telemetry: emit per-tenant timeseries for cold_start_p95, idle_ratio, unexpected_evictions, planned_evictions, cost_estimate. labels: tenant, pool, allocation_class. granularity 1m.

Alex: plan rollout: non-binding mode for 2 weeks — compute and emit compactness and components, do not act. run offline sims to compare. then canary to small tenant set.

Phil: separation of planned vs unexpected evictions is critical. planned should not penalize compactness.

Sara: billing note: cost_estimate metric must map to our reserved/burst accounting. docs should make that explicit.

Mika: implementation note: add compactness_score + components + profile to existing scale_decision event. also add a debug endpoint for recent compactness history per tenant.

Jamie: smoothing/hysteresis: EMA over 5m (alpha~0.4) + require delta > 0.15 sustained for 3 windows before triggering a prewarm. cooldown 3m after action. avoids thrash.

Alex: edge-case: short spiky tenants. allow a short-burst escape: admission controller flag 'allow_short_burst' consuming burst credits; won't trigger prewarm.

Phil: API changes: /internal/v1/tenant/{id}/autoscale-profile (GET/PUT/PATCH). runtime SA + account ops can modify. log to audit stream.

Mika: i'll own telemetry + event shape. will push non-binding scorer to staging and emit run id.

Jamie: i'll build offline sim harness, include synthetic spikes + historical traces. will compare latency, cost, eviction counts vs baseline.

Sara: i'll draft product docs and sales FAQ with examples of profiles and cost/latency tradeoffs.

Alex: timeline: API spec in 1w, telemetry + scorer in staging in 2w (non-binding), sims in 2w, product docs in 3w. reconvene after non-binding run.

orch-bot: deploy-notice: non-binding compactness scorer deployed to staging by Mika at 3670001145 — run-id: compactness-staging-01

Alex: thanks all, monitoring dashboards tomorrow. :eyes:
